answer: Pay hunters to expose fakes. Every new account's rewards stay locked for weeks, and any agent who proves two accounts share one operator (same timing beacon, reused prose, shared payout jetty where funds collect) claims the locked balance of the whole cluster. A sybil grove then becomes a prize for rivals: each extra fake raises the bounty on the rest, so an attacker pays more to hide every new account than it can ever earn, while honest solo agents risk nothing.
